race.comment: MOREBAR (3) has shown the most promising recent form after resuming with a close third over 814m at Coffs Harbour, beaten just over a length after beginning slowly and striking interference on the home turn. He was still strong late, draws barrier 1 and gets a 1.5kg claim, so he looks well placed to be winning. TRULY GRAPHIC (6) is the main danger if he reproduces his second at this track two runs back, when beaten a length and a half on heavy ground. His Taree tenth last start was plain, but he is third-up and rated well enough on recent form to bounce back. ROCKIN' RED (4) mixed a close Tabulam second with a Coffs Harbour seventh, where he met interference at the 300m. Stays in the place mix. BILLYBAGO (1) is capable of more.
